title: fix(platform-objects): Create User picks its permission set from a list, and a refused grant says in one line what to pick
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQWVv1Nxj3V5PkJPEMmeSk4)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwFtiPisvhAkegNCLQ

Fixes #30117

Clause-②: no (no new export, error code, accept set or schema key: a platform-objects param uses the existing `ActionParamSchema.widget`; the refusal keeps `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` / `reference_not_found`, only its sentence changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「新建用户」的「权限集」从只认机器名的空文本框，改成按标签列出权限集的可搜索下拉（`widget: 'permission-ref'`，就是授权表本身用的选择器）；Studio 的动作预览也画成下拉，和真实对话框一致。
- 拒绝提示：原来是一大段开发者说明；现在是一句业务话。输入的是某个权限集的标签时，直接说出它的名称，例如 "'Repair Technician' is the label of the permission set named 'asset_repair_technician': choose it from the list, or enter 'asset_repair_technician'."；同一句话覆盖所有授权路径（Setup 的授权表单与新建用户）。
- 不变的：依旧只接受名称，不接受标签；拒绝依旧是原子的，不会留下用户；状态码与错误码不变。
- 边界：只提示调用者能授予的集合；代理上限权限集（MCP agent）从不提示；非租户级管理员先被委托管理闸门拒绝，听不到任何集合名。
- 先看：`grant-permission-set-name.ts` 的 `grantSetNotInCatalogMessage` / `setsLabelled`，`sys-user.object.ts` 的 `permissionSet` 参数，`ActionPreview.tsx` 的 `runtimeWidgetFor`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位在 CI 绿后按落地授权落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`.** `create_user`'s inline `permissionSet` param adds `widget: 'permission-ref'` and keeps `type: 'text'`: the action dialog (since #30260) draws the grant column's own picker, a searchable list of the permission sets each shown by its label, submitting the chosen set's name. The stale comment "its picker is a widget hint params do not inherit" is retired. The param stays inline, so the dialog never needs plugin-security metadata to open.
- **`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx`.** `runtimeWidgetFor` now asks `paramToField` itself (with the authored `widget`) which widget the dialog draws, instead of `resolveParamWidgetType(type)`, so the preview's answer is `authoredWidgetKey(param) ?? resolveParamWidgetType(type)`, the dialog's expression, by construction (note 6662463937 line 2). A `permission-ref` answer is mocked as a disabled picker ("Select LABEL"); an unregistered widget name degrades to the `type` control, as in the dialog. `paramToField.ts` is not edited.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/grant-permission-set-name.ts`.** The shared refusal sentence (`grantSetNotInCatalogMessage`) is one line:
  - the refused value is one set's label (trimmed, any case): `'Repair Technician' is the label of the permission set named 'asset_repair_technician': choose it from the list, or enter 'asset_repair_technician'.`
  - a label several sets carry: they are listed, none is picked;
  - otherwise: `There is no permission set named 'xyz': choose one from the list.`
  The catalog is listed only on a refusal (`setsLabelled`); agent ceiling sets (`MCP_AGENT_PERMISSION_SETS`) are never suggested, the same exclusion the picker makes; a listing that throws leaves the plain sentence and is reported at `warn`. A label is still never accepted as a name.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-user-endpoints.ts`.** `grantRefusal` keeps "The permission set was not assigned, so no user was created" and hands the reason on as its own sentence (`. ` instead of `: `), so the composed answer reads as two sentences. Status, code, `fields` and the rollback are unchanged.
- **Changesets**, one per package moved, all `patch`, both declaration lines: `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Why

### Before (measured at `origin/main` `b77c160a`)

| | `main` | this PR |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `create_user.params.permissionSet` | `{ type: 'text' }`, no widget | `{ type: 'text', widget: 'permission-ref' }` |
| dialog control | text box (`ActionParamDialog.test.tsx` CONTROL cell, #30260) | permission-set picker (same file, picker cell) |
| Studio preview control | text box (`runtimeWidgetFor` → `resolveParamWidgetType('text')`) | disabled picker, `data-testid="action-preview-permission-ref"` |
| refusal for `'Repair Technician'` (Create User) | `The permission set was not assigned, so no user was created: Permission Set: no permission set is named 'Repair Technician'. sys_user_permission_set.permission_set takes the machine name of a permission set in the security catalog (a package's set, a built-in, or one saved through the metadata door), never a record id: write the name of an existing permission set, or declare the set first.` | `The permission set was not assigned, so no user was created. 'Repair Technician' is the label of the permission set named 'asset_repair_technician': choose it from the list, or enter 'asset_repair_technician'.` |
| user created on refusal | no | no |

### Who the picker lists

`permission-ref` lists `GET /api/v1/meta/permission` minus the agent ceiling sets; it is not filtered per caller. Create User is visible only to a platform administrator (`current_user.isPlatformAdmin`), a tenant-level administrator whom the ADR-0090 D12 gate admits for every set except the agent ceilings, which the picker leaves out. So for this action's audience the listed sets are the grantable sets. The picker does not narrow per delegate on other surfaces; that is the picker's existing behaviour and not changed here.

### The suggestion stays inside the caller's grant reach

The name check runs only after the D12 gate admitted the write. An organization administrator or a delegate naming a value the catalog does not hold is refused by the gate itself (`delegated-admin-gate.test.ts`, "not in the security catalog"), and a caller who administers nothing is refused 403 too, so neither hears a set name. Past the gate stand only tenant-level administrators. Pinned below.

## Verification

Tests added or changed (all green locally):

- `plugin-security` `grant-permission-set-name.test.ts`, new describe "the refusal says, in one line, what to pick instead" (7 cells, real `ObjectQL` + SQL driver + `SecurityPlugin`): plain sentence with no developer vocabulary; label → name; case/space-insensitive match; shared label lists both; agent ceiling never suggested; caller refused by the D12 gate hears no set name (403, nothing stored); unlistable catalog still refuses with the plain sentence and warns. Every cell asserts nothing is stored. File: 23 passed.
- `plugin-auth` `admin-user-endpoints.test.ts`: the refusal's composed message, `fields` and rollback; the param pin adds `widget: 'permission-ref'`. 99 passed.
- `platform-objects` `sys-user-create-user-email-required.test.ts`, new top-level describe pinning the param on the SOURCE (plugin-auth's pin reads the built dist, see ablation B2). 6 passed.
- `ui` `ActionDesigner.paramVocabulary.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (4 cells): the dialog's adapter answers `permission-ref`; the preview draws the picker; CONTROL without widget is a text box; an unregistered widget degrades to the text box. 23 passed.
- `qa/dogfood` `create-user-permission-set.dogfood.test.ts` (real showcase boot, real route): G2 pins the composed message; new G4 sends the label `Showcase Contributor` and gets 400 naming `showcase_contributor`, zero users. 4 passed.

Ablations (old behaviour put back, red seen, restored):

- A1 old developer sentence: 6 of the new plugin-security cells red (`Received: "Permission Set: no permission set is named 'qa_nowhere'. sys_user_permission_set.permission_set takes the machine name …"`).
- A2 no label lookup: the 3 label cells and the unlistable-catalog warn cell red (`Received: "There is no permission set named 'QA Alpha': choose one from the list."`).
- A3 agent ceiling not excluded: the agent cell red (`Received: "'QA Agent Reader' is the label of the permission set named 'mcp_agent_data_read': …"`).
- A4 reach cell run with a tenant-admin caller: red (the suggestion appears), so the cell measures the gate's ordering.
- B1 old `: ` joiner: plugin-auth refusal cell red.
- B2 widget removed from the param: plugin-auth stays green (it reads `@objectstack/platform-objects` dist), which is why the source pin C1 exists; C1 red (`- "widget": "permission-ref"`).
- D1 preview ignores `widget`: the preview picker cell red (`Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="action-preview-permission-ref"]`).

Gates (head `b5c69de7`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles 71 derived families: 70 run, all exit 0; 1 NOT MEASURED, `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 (its positive control is pinned to commit `621a4876`, unreachable in this shallow clone; checker-health only). Also exit 0: `pnpm lint`; `typecheck` and `test` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`. Record: `gates-ran-b5c69de7.txt` in the seat's project folder.

Skills-docs: none owed by this diff. `git grep -n "create_user\|permissionSet" -- skills` has no hit; `content/docs/**` has no copy of the refusal sentence. `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` ("Create a User Directly") documents `create-user` without the optional `permissionSet` at all, a gap that predates this PR; follow-up candidate.

## Deviations

- File surface: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/create-user-permission-set.dogfood.test.ts` (test-only, outside the order's list), accepted by the seat for the end-to-end label case.
- The refusal names a set's name when the refused value is a set's label (a catalog list read on the refusal path only), beyond rewording; the seat asked that the suggestion stay inside the caller's grant reach, pinned above.
- `ActionPreview` mocks `permission-ref` as a picker, one key past the eight `PARAM_TYPE_OPTS` the preview's mock vocabulary covered, because a text box there would still contradict the dialog.
- Full `pnpm test` across the monorepo was not run; the four moved packages' suites, the ui previews/designer suites and the dogfood file were.

## Acceptance notes

- The result dialog's `Permission Set` row still shows the granted set's name, not its label (`resultDialog.fields` path `permissionSet`); not in the card's ask.
- A translated label (for example a zh-CN label) is not matched by the suggestion: the catalog's `label` is the source string.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.test.tsx` mocks a server message with the old wording as its fixture; it pins that the form shows the server's words, whatever they are, so it is left as is.
